component.name: Whispr Dictation
component.summary: Dictate into the window you are already typing in

description.p: Whispr is a COSMIC panel applet for dictation. Press a keyboard shortcut, say what you mean, press it again: the recording goes to a speech-to-text service and the transcript is typed into whichever window has focus, so the words land where you were already working.

A second shortcut copies to the clipboard instead, for the times typing into the focused window would be wrong — a password field, a terminal holding a half-written command, someone else's chat window.

ul.li: Filler words, stutters and false starts are removed by an optional second pass, which can only delete words you actually said.
The API key is kept in the system keyring and nowhere else, and is never sent to an endpoint that is neither HTTPS nor loopback.
Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works, including a local whisper.cpp or faster-whisper server, which needs no key at all.
